findings.title: Prompt/skill loading has confinement gaps outside centralized resource-policy validation
save_knowledge does not enforce the active project's knowledge_repos association
Runtime skill discovery does not enforce the shipped skill validation contract before shadowing/activation
The cron skill misdocuments reminder execution and default timezone semantics
The ClawHub skill installs and manages skills in the default workspace instead of the effective agent workspace
The tmux skill recommends launching Codex with its approvals and sandbox disabled
Mobile testing skills require both platform toolchains even though each supports either platform
video-understanding silently bypasses Nanobot provider routing for semantic frame analysis
webapp-testing recommends a caller-supplied CDP mode that the live browser wrapper always blocks
Non-positive video max-gap values can spin forever before frame capping
Live prompt guidance advertises retired search/edit tools absent from the default registry
Degraded compaction can elevate raw transcript/tool text into the future system prompt
Dream can persist skill instructions outside its own audit and restore boundary

final_discussion_questions.question: D2/D4: Should every prompt, context-repo entrypoint, prompt override and non-builtin skill read pass one effective ResourceAccessPolicy regardless of managed mode?
D4: Is knowledge_repos an enforceable project ownership boundary or advisory discovery metadata; if global writes remain, should they be separate?
D4/P01: Should invalid skills be rejected before precedence/shadowing with one shared creator/package/runtime validator, or is a compatibility tier required?
D4/D6: Should bundled operational skills derive workspace, timezone, route, platform prerequisites and browser-control semantics from live runtime metadata?
D2/D4: Should nested-agent sandbox/approval bypass flags be classified as an authority escalation requiring explicit approval/proven containment?
D2/D4: Must auxiliary semantic media analysis use the active Nanobot provider/policy/accounting route, or may it select a separate provider/key/model?
D2/D7: Must degraded archived raw transcript/tool evidence remain lower-authority data instead of being inserted into the system prompt?
D4/D7/P01: Should Dream remain memory-only, or should its audit/restore transaction include every instruction surface it may mutate, including workspace skills?

cross_module_dependencies_and_conflicts: T01-F10 owns the underlying apply_patch registration omission; K01-F11 owns the broader live prompt/skill synchronization mismatch and missing grep/find_files workflow. Deduplicate in integrated review.
A01-F02 owns the shipped /goal registration mismatch; K01 retains the unrendered goal_runtime template only as compatibility evidence.
D2/D4/D7 decisions govern prompt/resource authority, nested-agent/provider routing, archived-context authority and Dream mutation ownership.
P01 should decide restoration versus retirement of stale capability guidance and whether Dream skill mutation belongs in the product at all.
